invariants.rationale: If bucketInfoMap always contains entries for all possible bucketNumber values passed in, then result should not be null.
The method returns exactly bucketInfoMap.get(bucketNumber), so this equality always holds.
If bucketNumber represents a valid bucket index, it should be non-negative.
If result is non-null it should always be an instance of BucketInfo as returned from the map.
If the map contains the key, the result is non-null; if the map does not contain the key, the result is null.
